rule: design D22: collect copies a finished job's text records (*.json, *.jsonl, *.txt; nothing under partial/, traces/, logs/ or work/; of checkpoints/ only checkpoint_<n>.json; never LIVE.json) to their committed place, verifies each copy by sha256 and writes COLLECTED.json; a source that is still running is refused (a LIVE.json that is fresh and not closed without DONE.json or HALT.json; a lock whose holder is alive; a run.json that reads running whose process is alive); a file already there with other bytes is refused
